messages.subject: Plate compactor - date change needed
messages.body:
Hi,

I have a plate compactor booked from the Kempele depot but I need to move the dates. The work on my yard got pushed back. Can you check what's available?

Thanks,
Teemu Alatalo

messages.subject: Re: Plate compactor - date change needed
messages.body:
Hi Teemu,

Got your message. I'll check the Kempele schedule for the plate compactor and get back to you with available dates.

Marko Seppälä
Branch Manager

messages.subject: Re: Plate compactor - date change needed
messages.body:
Marko,

One more thing. I received the damage assessment for booking RB-20262082 and there's a charge of 260 euros on the plate compactor. I don't think this is justified at all. The compactor had normal use marks, nothing out of the ordinary. I've been renting from you for years and this has never happened before.

I'd like to have the charge waived.

Teemu
